**Pull Request** (PR) tools: PR viewer, PR report, PR file views, commit selection, branch selection and code comments. - Review a task's files and proposed changes directly from a chat. ### GitHub integration - Browse **help-wanted** issues and read individual issues. - **Process an issue with AI** to turn it into work. - A Git-issue **wizard** helps you go from issue to task. --- ## Teams & Collaboration Teams let people (and AI profiles) collaborate inside a project. ### Teams, channels & DMs - Create **teams** with a name, icon, colour, description and tags. - Organise conversations into **categories** and **channels**. - Hold **direct messages** with individual team members. - A team sidebar shows channels, members and quick links to recent chats. ### Members & AI profiles - Add **members** with roles and online status. - Attach **AI profiles** to a team to bring assistants into the collaboration. - Manage members, roles and statuses for each team. ### Team media - Each team has a **media library** for images, video and other files shared by the team. ### Team settings - Dedicated screens for **Team**, **Channel**, **Category** and **Member** settings, plus dialogs to **create teams**, **create channels** and **add members**. --- ## Messenger & Activity Wall ### Messenger A dedicated **Messenger** view for conversations, keeping team and direct messaging in one place. ### Activity Wall The **Activity Wall** is a social-style feed of everything happening across your projects. -
